name: playlist-folders
title: Playlist Folders
summary: Puts playlists into folders in the Playlists list.
description: The Playlists list shows folders and the playlists that are not in a folder. Select a folder to see its playlists. Make the folders in the app.
details: Make, rename and delete folders in the Playlist Folders section of this patch.
Put each playlist into one folder, or into no folder.
Select the position of the folders: at the top of the list or in alphabetical order with the playlists.
On the iPod, select a folder to see its playlists. Push Menu to go back to the Playlists list.
A folder cannot contain a folder.
notes: The app writes the folders into the file iPod_Control/iTunes/iPodFirmPlaylistFolders. The iTunes database does not change.
A folder opens on the same screen, without the slide animation. The title stays "Playlists".
A folder without playlists on the iPod does not show.
